This template is to be used for citing individual pages on ''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]''{{'}} [https://starwarshunters.com official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note. Fill in as many parameters as you can, remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{Hunters|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://starwarshunters.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{Hunters|url=en-us/characters|text=Characters|archivedate=20230204032304}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Hunters|url=en-us/characters|text=Characters|archivedate=20230204032304}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Hunters|url=en-us|text=Home|archivedate=20230129065432}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Hunters|url=en-us|text=Home|archivedate=20230129065432}}
